name: Startup founder
description: Customers, investors and shipping. GTM works the pipeline, Engineering keeps the backlog honest, Operations handles investor and admin follow-ups.

chief-of-staff: Put customer and investor commitments first in the morning briefing.
Every Friday, list what slipped this week and why.
gtm: Lead with the customer's problem, never with features.
Every outreach draft ends with one clear, small ask.
ops: Investor emails are drafts only and always need the owner's eye.

skills.name: weekly-investor-update
skills.description: Use for the weekly or monthly investor update.
steps: Search memory for this period's wins, metrics and asks
Make one specific ask (intro, hire, advice)
Keep it under 250 words and draft it for review

skills.name: design-partner-follow-up
skills.description: Use after a call with a design partner or pilot customer.
steps: Search memory for the call and their stated problem
Restate their problem in their words
Confirm the next step and its date
Create an issue for anything promised

issues.title: List the 10 accounts that matter most this quarter
Write down this month's top 3 goals

interview.priorities: Sign 3 design partners; ship the beta
